usageNotes: Use this to modify metadata on an existing CIDR entry within a named IPSet on an LXC container's firewall — specifically to update its comment or toggle the 'nomatch' (exclusion) flag. The CIDR itself is immutable by this endpoint; to change the address, delete the old entry and add a new one. Requires VM.Config.Network on the target container.

examples.summary: Mark a CIDR entry as an exclusion (nomatch) and add an explanatory comment

params.comment: Exclude legacy subnet from trusted management range

tips: Pass 'digest' to guard against concurrent edits — read the IPSet entry first (GET the same path) to retrieve the current digest, then include it here.
Setting 'nomatch: true' turns the CIDR into an explicit exclusion within the IPSet, useful for carving out sub-ranges from a broader allowed block.
The IPSet must already exist and the CIDR entry must already be present; this endpoint updates in-place and does not create.
Changes take effect immediately in the firewall rules engine — no container restart required.
